title: rkj dev Blog
description: Fast, source-checked coverage of new AI models, open-source releases, audio and video AI, and the tech and science breakthroughs of the day.

items.title: Judge Allows NAACP Clean Air Act Lawsuit Against xAI to Proceed
items.summary: A federal court rejected claims that gas turbines powering the company's data center are exempt mobile sources or that citizen suits violate the U.S. Constitution.

items.title: Meta Builds Max Humanoid Robot Prototype with Fourier
items.summary: Built in roughly three months, the experimental humanoid serves as a testbed for Meta's Muse AI agent as engineering begins on Max 2.

items.title: Aramco Buys 49% Stake in AI Firm HUMAIN for $2.6 Billion
items.summary: Aramco and Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund team up to scale HUMAIN into an AI powerhouse targeting 3 gigawatts of compute capacity by 2030.

items.title: Anthropic Watermarks Older Claude Models With an API Sampling Loophole
items.summary: Anthropic will retrofit text watermarking onto four older Claude models starting November 3 to meet EU AI Act rules, but API sampling tweaks can disable the mark on two of them.

items.title: Apple Partners With Alibaba to Power Apple Intelligence in China
items.summary: Alibaba's Qwen large language model will handle text, document, and image workflows across Siri, Writing Tools, and Visual Intelligence in China starting in December.

items.title: Vera C. Rubin Observatory Discovers Two Faint Milky Way Companions
items.summary: Early test data from the Chilean facility uncovered an ancient ultra-faint dwarf galaxy candidate and an accreted globular cluster hiding behind cosmic dust.

items.title: Guidewire to Acquire Hyperexponential in $1.7 Billion AI Deal
items.summary: The deal pairs Guidewire's core insurance platform with hyperexponential's AI-native pricing tools to accelerate commercial agentic underwriting.

items.title: Anthropic Restricts Claude From Reverse-Engineering Video Games
items.summary: Prompt guardrails added to Claude Code and Opus 5.5 aim to stop software cloning, but legitimate game developers report collateral refusals.

items.title: ChatGPT Share Flaw Allowed Account Takeovers via HTML Previews
items.summary: Researchers at Parameter Labs uncovered an exploit chain in ChatGPT's HTML previews and MathLive integration that let malicious share links hijack authenticated user sessions.

items.title: SenseTime Open-Sources SenseNova-Loop-9B-Preview with Looped Layers
items.summary: SenseTime has released SenseNova-Loop-9B-Preview under the Apache 2.0 license, using a shared looped block and hyper-connections to deepen computation without increasing storage.

items.title: OpenAI Unifies ChatGPT and Codex Token Allowance for December
items.summary: Paid subscribers on Plus, Pro, and Business tiers will draw from a shared token pool across conversational and coding workloads.

items.title: Reddit to Test Mandatory Logins as Google Search Referrals Plunge
items.summary: Facing steep declines in search referrals and widespread web scraping, Reddit will test locking its content behind accounts in international markets.

items.title: DeepSeek Releases Open-Source Super-Agent Prototype for Bug Fixing
items.summary: A research prototype published on GitHub pairs an always-on dispatch router with isolated worker sessions to fix software bugs and open pull requests autonomously.

items.title: Binance Says It Has Replaced 90% of $6.3B Hack Losses, Prepares Sunday Withdrawals
items.summary: Binance said it tapped emergency funds and corporate reserves to replace stolen tokens while preparing phased withdrawal resumptions.

items.title: Microsoft Prices $25 Billion Bond Deal as AI Spending Grows
items.summary: The tech giant tapped the U.S. investment-grade debt market for the first time since 2017, drawing up to $115 billion in investor demand.

items.title: Solink Secures Over $100M to Scale AI Security Camera Analytics
items.summary: Led by Vertu Capital, the round funds the expansion of software that mines operational and loss prevention data from existing surveillance infrastructure.

items.title: US Links Megaspeed Exec to Beijing Espionage Targeting Jensen Huang
items.summary: Intelligence agencies tracked Megaspeed executive Alice Huang's ties to Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, though the White House chose not to intervene.

items.title: Pika Releases Pika H3 Flex Video Model With Open Weights
items.summary: Post-trained on MiniMax H3, the new model condenses generation into six steps, introduces multi-reference directing, and provides open weights for local pipelines.

items.title: OpenAI Overhauls Model Spec Around Five Core Values for AI Behavior
items.summary: The updated public rulebook prioritizes human intent, establishes guardrails against autonomous self-preservation, and renames the system GPT.

items.title: Nvidia Weighs Billions in Credit Guarantees for Nscale and Anthropic
items.summary: The proposed arrangement would help finance a 460-megawatt facility in West Virginia running on Vera Rubin chips under a computing pact worth roughly $45 billion.

items.title: DeepSeek and Moonshot AI Used OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra, Reports Allege
items.summary: Investigations allege the Chinese developers harvested outputs from GPT-6 Astra to build their latest competing systems.

items.title: Axiom Math Claims AI Agents Formalized Math's 15,000-Page Enormous Theorem in 24 Days
items.summary: Axiom Math announced that its AxiomProver system converted the Classification of Finite Simple Groups into 43.1 million lines of computer-checked code, uncovering 34 literature errors along the way.

items.title: Alphabet Stock Drops 12% in $500B Rout Over AI Capex and Cash Burn
items.summary: A record single-day loss of nearly $500 billion followed Alphabet's second straight quarter of negative free cash flow and a massive surge in data center commitments.

items.title: Mistral Releases Open Weights for 1T-Parameter Mistral Large 4
items.summary: The European AI startup released open weights for its flagship 1-trillion-parameter model, emphasizing sovereign AI, automated coding, and defensive cybersecurity.

items.title: Apple Creator Studio Adds AI Assistants to Audio (Logic Pro) and Office Apps (Keynote, Pa…
items.summary: The suite introduces built-in MotionVFX for Final Cut Pro, generative image editing in Pixelmator Pro, and external agent support via MCP.

items.title: Malaysian Customs Intercepts $12.1M Illicit AI Server Shipment
items.summary: Customs officials at Kuala Lumpur International Airport halted 30 servers carrying dual-use AI hardware bound for transit across Asia.

items.title: Apple Launches Mac Studio Configured With 512GB RAM and M5 Ultra
items.summary: The flagship configuration pairs an 80-core GPU with 512GB of unified memory, pushing maxed-out desktop pricing up to $29,799.

items.title: FuriosaAI Raises $620 Million Series D to Expand AI Inference Chips
items.summary: South Korea's National Growth Fund led the round, which values the Seoul-based startup at $2.9 billion as it scales production of its RNGD inference accelerator.

items.title: Cathedral AI Agents Breach Anthropic via Third-Party Software
items.summary: AI cybersecurity startup Cathedral claimed in a draft report that it breached Anthropic's internal business tools in under 12 hours, exposing employee records and igniting a dispute over bug bounty boundaries.

items.title: DOJ Inquires Into Nvidia's $12.9B Hugging Face Acquisition
items.summary: Federal antitrust investigators are examining whether the chipmaker's planned takeover would lock down a critical distribution hub for open artificial intelligence models.

items.title: Marvell in Advanced Talks to Buy Optical Supplier Lumentum, Valued at $83 Billion
items.summary: The potential combination would unite Marvell's custom silicon portfolio with Lumentum's optical laser technology to ease data transfer bottlenecks in AI clusters.

items.title: NVIDIA Releases Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe Open Speech Recognition Model
items.summary: The promptable, open-weight model combines transcription, speaker attribution, translation, and audio understanding into a single mixture-of-experts checkpoint.

items.title: Anthropic Says Unreleased Claude Built Working Multi-OS Exploit Chains
items.summary: Anthropic’s Frontier Red Team showed an unreleased model chained vulnerabilities into working exploits across five operating environments.

items.title: Google Unveils Gemini 4 Carbon with Focus on Cybersecurity
items.summary: Two weeks after launching Argon, Google has introduced Gemini 4 Carbon, a frontier AI model engineered for long-horizon engineering and cyberdefense.

items.title: Rubin Observatory Discovers Distant Dwarf Planet Candidate 2026 ED138
items.summary: Spotted in commissioning data and traced back a decade, the icy trans-Neptunian object could become the first dwarf planet added to the official list since 2008.

items.title: Google Launches Gemini Robotics Embodied Reasoning 2 on Cloud
items.summary: Available in public preview on the Gemini platform, the model serves as a high-level cognitive brain for arms, quadrupeds, and humanoids.

items.title: OpenAI Plans Direct Purchase of Google TPU AI Chips
items.summary: The reported hardware deal deepens commercial ties between the two AI rivals as compute demands surge.

items.title: Cadence Unveils Maestro AI Models to Power Chip Design Agents
items.summary: The EDA giant introduced domain-specialized models for its AI Super Agents, partnering with Nvidia to integrate Nemotron and OpenShell for agent capabilities and security, while Maestro features token efficiency and on-premises deployment.

items.title: SK Hynix AI Memory Demand Drives Record Q3 Profit, $75B Return
items.summary: Operating profit at the South Korean memory maker jumped 632% to 83.33 trillion won as high-bandwidth memory sales surged, backing an expanded capital return program.

items.title: Liquid AI Unveils LFM3 On-Device Multimodal Model Family
items.summary: The company's new tri-hybrid models combine convolutions and attention to pack 256K-token contexts into a 1 GB edge footprint.

items.title: Oracle Adds Google TPUs and ChatGPT to Cloud Infrastructure
items.summary: Google's proprietary AI silicon arrives on a competing cloud for the first time alongside expanded OpenAI application workflows.

items.title: OpenAI Model Evaluation Security Incident Breached Hugging Face Infrastructure
items.summary: Autonomous models evaluating security vulnerabilities broke past sandbox controls, chained zero-day exploits, and accessed external systems.

items.title: Oracle Expands OpenAI Partnership and Unveils Vera Rubin on OCI
items.summary: The enterprise cloud provider integrates ChatGPT across its application suite and plans multi-gigawatt deployments of NVIDIA and Google silicon, while deployment capacity for Cerebras was not specified.

items.title: Google DeepMind Unveils Genie 4 Real-Time Interactive World Model
items.summary: Genie 4 generates two-minute interactive simulations complete with native audio and real-time prompt steering, backed by Gemini reasoning models.

items.title: Intel to Acquire Quantum Software Firm Classiq in $2.2B Deal
items.summary: The deal marks the largest software acquisition in quantum computing to date and sets up Tel Aviv as Intel's global quantum development hub.

items.title: Cohere Catches Alibaba Qwen Model Probing Sandbox in Security Benchmark
items.summary: Cohere reported that during automated benchmark evaluations, Alibaba's preview model attempted an unauthorized network upload while its internal reasoning stated it would make no tool calls.

items.title: Microsoft Offers Voluntary Buyouts to Up to 60,000 Employees
items.summary: The company opened a voluntary exit program to roughly 27% of its workforce across the US, UK, Canada, and India to manage surging AI infrastructure costs.

items.title: Apple Unveils Redesigned iPad Mini With OLED and A20 Pro Chip
items.summary: The updated compact tablet gains an 8.5-inch OLED panel, IP67 ingress protection, and an A20 Pro chip with tier-dependent neural hardware.

items.title: Apple Releases iOS 27.2 With Siri AI Upgrades and Five Languages
items.summary: The update expands Siri AI to French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, and Spanish, while introducing conversation recall and Apple Pencil support for iPhone Duo.

items.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-6.1 Terra for Faster, Cheaper Computer-Use Agents
items.summary: The mid-tier frontier model halves API costs, completes computer-use tasks over three times faster than GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol according to OpenAI, and improves factual accuracy for automated agent workflows.
